title: The Lunchbox
text: Quiet, character-driven Mumbai story. Warm, unhurried, emotionally gentle. Strong acting, slow pacing, comfort rather than spectacle.

title: Paddington
text: Kind, low-stakes, comforting family film. Not intense. Good for exhausted evenings.

title: Whiplash
text: High-intensity, stressful, loud, ambitious. Poor fit for exhausted low-intensity nights.

title: Quiet cafe in Navrangpura (seed)
text: Low music, sockets, comfort food under 300 rupees, not a club. Solo-friendly.

title: Late-night club (seed negative)
text: Loud, crowded, high intensity dancing, expensive cover.

title: Cozy evening pattern
text: Short walk, quiet cafe, comfort meal, light movie, calming playlist. Budget under 1000 INR. Solo.

title: Relaxation after cognitive fatigue
text: After college fatigue, prefer low stimulation, warm food, familiar media, limited travel, dim social load.
